<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a Diels‑Alder type transformation that breaks two C=C bonds of a diene and one C=C bond of a dienophile and forms two new C‑C single bonds while changing the bond orders of the involved alkenes. This should match the target molecule COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
